AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
This app shows the DevFest Ourense 2026 agenda (7 Nov 2026) and the user's favourite sessions.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchTalks' to resolve sessions to IDs before calling 'addToFavorites'. - Prefer one 'addToFavorites' call with several IDs over repeated calls. - To find a session by speaker or title, pass the text as 'query' to 'searchTalks'.
Constraints: - 'clearFavorites' is irreversible: confirm with the user before calling it. - Times are local to the event (Europe/Madrid) and formatted HH:mm. - Tracks are an unofficial classification: ai, android, web, demo, general.
